public_body: North Reading Wastewater Planning Advisory Committee
overall: The AG found neither body violated the OML: the Advisory Committee never held meetings, and the Working Group is not a public body subject to the law.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Wastewater Planning Advisory Committee held meetings without complying with notice and access requirements.
allegations.key_passage: A quorum of a 13-member public body that has only two serving members remains seven, so even if two individuals were appointed to the Advisory Committee, discussions among the two of them would not constitute meetings subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Wastewater Working Group held meetings without complying with notice and access requirements; the Town argued the group is not a public body.
allegations.key_passage: Here, too, we conclude that the Working Group is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.
